definitions.gloss: box tissues; tissue box; boxed facial tissues
definitions.explanation: Facial tissues sold in a rectangular box, as opposed to pocket tissues. A ubiquitous household item in Japan found in virtually every home, office, and car.

examples.japanese: {箱|はこ}ティッシュが{切|き}れた。
examples.english: We ran out of box tissues.

examples.japanese: {花粉|かふん}の{季節|きせつ}は{箱|はこ}ティッシュの{消費|しょうひ}が{増|ふ}える。
examples.english: Tissue box consumption increases during pollen season.

examples.japanese: ドラッグストアで{五箱|ごはこ}パックの{箱|はこ}ティッシュを{安売|やすう}りしていたので、まとめ{買|が}いした。
examples.english: The drugstore had five-box packs of tissues on sale, so I bought in bulk.

notes:
A compound of {箱|はこ} (box) and ティッシュ (tissue, from English). In Japan, box tissues are typically sold in multi-packs of five and are a staple household purchase. Distinguished from ポケットティッシュ (pocket tissues), which are commonly handed out for free on streets as advertising.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {箱|はこ}ティッシュ{五箱|ごはこ}パック: five-box tissue pack
- {箱|はこ}ティッシュカバー: tissue box cover
- {箱|はこ}ティッシュを{買|か}う: to buy box tissues

RELATED WORDS:
- ポケットティッシュ: pocket tissues — small packs given out free in Japan as advertising
- ティッシュペーパー: tissue paper — the generic term for facial tissue
- ウェットティッシュ: wet tissues / wet wipes
